sources.title: pixai-labs/pixai-tagger-v1.0 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Tagger v1.0 reaches 0.6660 micro F1, a 2.25 percentage-point lead over the next model, and 0.3807 mAP on 8,407 shared General tags. These results describe the evaluated models and dataset, rather than every available tagger.

sources.snippet: PixAI Tagger ONNX GUI uses multiple local models—including the ONNX version of the image tagging model developed by PixAI —and optional network VLMs to generate tags and captions for images. The original PixAI Tagger supports over 13,000 rich tags, offering an advantage compared to common tagging models (e.g., wd-tagger's ~10,000 tags). sources.title: PixAI Tagging System | deepghs/imgutils | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The PixAI Tagging System provides anime-style image tagging capabilities using specialized neural network models developed by the PixAI team. This system processes images to extract relevant tags categorized into general content descriptors and character identification, with additional support for mapping characters to their associated intellectual properties (IPs).
